_note: Every interface label. Urdu and Pashto drafted by the team and pending a native-speaker review. {placeholders} are filled in by js/app.js.

en.tap_district: Tap a district on the map or in the list.
en.tap_uc: Tap a union council for its ten-day chart and CSV.
en.legend_green: Rain covered what the crops needed
en.legend_nodata: No cropland mapped, or a source was missing
en.legend_note: Deficit is the water crops needed minus the rain they received over ten days, across {basis}. It describes a whole union council.
en.layer_note: Hectares from ESA WorldCover 2021, shaded by rank within this district.
en.layer_note_province: Hectares from ESA WorldCover 2021, shaded by rank across the province.
en.status_sentence: {ha} ha of {basis} lie under this signal.
en.rule_green: Rule: rain was at least what the crops needed.
en.nodata_no_crop: No cropland was mapped here, so no water balance is computed.
en.nodata_missing: A source was missing for this period.
en.trend_up: The deficit has grown {n} ten-day periods in a row.
en.trend_up_one: The deficit grew since the previous ten days.
en.trend_flat: The deficit did not grow since the previous ten days.
en.no_series: No time series for this unit yet.
en.crop_year_note: Crop areas come from the 2021 ESA WorldCereal map (about 100 m), so they show where crops were mapped in 2021, not this period.
en.crop_type_notice: Winter cereals, maize and irrigated area need ESA WorldCereal through Earth Engine. They are reported as unavailable rather than estimated.
en.detail_on: Union council outlines are shown. Zoom out for districts only.
en.detail_off: Zoom in to reveal every union council across the province.
en.layer_note_pct: Where this ten-day deficit ranks against the same ten days in {from}–{to}, at the same location and with the same method. Context only: it does not change the traffic light.
en.hist_aria: This ten-day deficit sits at the {pct}th percentile of the historical record, where 100 is the driest
en.hist_sentence: This deficit was larger than in {pct} of every 100 years for these ten days. Typical deficit for these ten days: {normal} mm.
en.hist_unusual: Among the driest {share} of every 100 years for this time of year.
en.hist_red_typical: Red under the fixed rule, but not unusual for this time of year.
en.hist_note: Same method and location, {from}–{to}. Context only; it does not change the colour.
en.headline_red: {red} of {n} districts are red under the fixed {max} mm rule.
en.headline_typical: {typical} of them are ordinary for this time of year.
en.headline_unusual: {unusual} districts are among the driest {share} of every 100 years for this period.
